dict.Paginile cu transparență (opacitate, umb: Pages with transparency (opacity, soft shadows, blend modes) become an image at the chosen resolution, with the text still searchable, for print shops that require flattened transparency (PDF/X-1a)
dict.Textul rămâne căutabil (pus invizibil pe: Keep the text searchable (invisible over the image)
dict.Unele tipografii (fluxurile PDF/X-1a) nu: Some print shops (PDF/X-1a workflows) do not accept transparency: opacity, soft shadows and blend modes. Pages that use it are drawn exactly as they look and become an image at the resolution below; links, comments, the trim box and the page size stay. Other pages do not change. Ctrl+Z undoes.
